title: Teacher hire cohorts
statementMd:
How many teachers were hired in each decade (2000s, 2010s, 2020s)? Show the decade start year and count.

Expected columns: `decade`, `teachers`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT hired_year / 10 * 10 AS decade, COUNT(*) AS teachers FROM teachers GROUP BY decade;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
